draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.60, the 242nd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 17th of 18 at TE. He went 208th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (242nd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 326 receiving yards in 2021, 11th of 19 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Las Vegas Raiders. 68 career games and 14 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2022. Weak spots: season snap share 8.7% (4th percentile), receiving yards 21 (7th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 tight end who played: 21 receiving yards against a median of 179, below the norm.
